COM.note: The data centre is for public administration; no hire, tier or cloud region stated.
Universal service fund use for schools and health centres is only envisaged; no rural programme delivered or measured.

facts.fact: ANADEN and Comores Cables officially launched the public administration's data centre on 19 May 2025, which the promoters frame as a step for digital sovereignty.

COM.note: Minister only envisages mobilising the universal service fund; no budget amount or act stated.
Ownership, hire and tier of the data centre not stated.
Minister says the country collaborates with Smart Africa on group purchasing; membership or an agreement is not stated.
